brainSettings.title: Brain settings
brainSettings.description: How this brain looks and behaves across the console: its name, colour, image and defaults.
brainSettings.readOnly: You can view these settings. Only the brain's owner can change them.
brainSettings.limited: As an editor you can change the description and colour. The owner manages everything else.
brainSettings.general.title: General
brainSettings.general.hint: The name, description, icon and colour people see for this brain.
brainSettings.general.namespaceHint: Renaming changes the shown name only. The namespace id stays
brainSettings.general.descriptionPlaceho: What this brain holds and who it is for
brainSettings.general.descriptionHint: Plain text; line breaks are kept. {count} characters left.
brainSettings.general.iconHint: An emoji shown when the brain has no image.
brainSettings.general.colorHint: Pick a swatch or enter a hex colour. Reset returns to the brain's default colour.
brainSettings.general.defaultCategoryHin: New notes get this category when none is chosen.
brainSettings.general.visibilityHint: A label only. Access is always decided by membership.
brainSettings.appearance.title: Appearance
brainSettings.appearance.hint: The avatar appears in the brain switcher, on brain cards and in the overview. Images are only visible to the brain's members.
brainSettings.appearance.imageHint: Cropped to a square in your browser.
brainSettings.appearance.rules: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. SVG is not accepted.
brainSettings.appearance.invalid: That file is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP image under 2 MB.
brainSettings.members.title: Members
brainSettings.members.hint: Who can use this brain. Owners manage everything, editors read and write, viewers read.
brainSettings.members.ownerOnly: Only the brain's owner can see and manage its members.
brainSettings.members.removeBody: {who} loses access to this brain immediately.
brainSettings.members.rolesHint: Editors can also change the brain's description and colour.
brainSettings.danger.title: Danger zone
brainSettings.danger.hint: Export a full copy, or delete the brain and everything in it.
brainSettings.danger.exportHint: Download every memory as NDJSON, ready to import elsewhere.
brainSettings.danger.deleteHint: Removes every memory, gap and setting in this brain. This cannot be undone.
